name: svlt
description: Use a local macOS vault for secrets the user chooses to manage, without returning SVLT-managed plaintext to Codex, Claude, Hermes, or other MCP agents.

interface.shortDescription: Opt-in encrypted secret references without exposing SVLT-managed plaintext.
interface.longDescription: SVLT connects MCP-capable agents to a local macOS app over authenticated IPC for secrets the user chooses to manage. Agents can inspect secret:// references, bind an exact service destination with fresh owner approval, request local reveal, export app-resolved text to local files, and perform restricted local SSH, HTTP/API, database, SFTP/SCP, browser-login, and app-form actions without returning SVLT-managed plaintext. User-selected external providers and explicitly supplied plaintext remain outside SVLT scope.
defaultPrompt: Use a local device credential without revealing plaintext.
